ItemID: NA; Title: 5/16"-18 Stainless Hex Nut (100 Pack), by Bolt Dropper, 304 18-8 Stainless Steel Nuts; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current project requiring this exact thread size or a hundred nuts.
